description: The non-agent portion of EXP-003's launch-to-final-report path on the frozen CASE-003 package: integrity verification and reuse checking (run --plan), an evaluated run with committed-receipt reuse (run), and fresh execution (run --no-reuse). The agent and unattended-orchestration portions of EXP-003 are not part of this workload and are not claimed.
candidate: candidates/reference.json (the committed reference specimen, supplied as the free input `candidate`)
cache_policy: committed-receipt reuse on by default; no hash cache; the scratch campaign log lives in the results directory, never in the case
build: cargo build --release -p avila-core-cli (workspace default release profile)

phases.verify: avila-core run --plan: package integrity, compile, coverage, and current reuse check without launching solver steps
phases.reuse: avila-core run: the same path plus claim generation, binding, and evaluation against committed receipts
phases.fresh: avila-core run --no-reuse: full step execution; requires the pinned capability executables to resolve
phases.manual_setup: human work outside the timed path: locating source roots, keys, and candidate file (performed once, documented, not repeated)
